**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) | `options.retries` renamed to `retryCount` | read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | treat `undefined` as off |

The 8 remaining warnings are real deprecations, not noise. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is the one to fix next. It must go before v5.
